overview_description.description: DoorsVision is a smart community and smart city technology platform focused on IoT-based building access, visitor management, smart intercom, smart parking, energy management, and community communication systems. The platform connects residents, businesses, property managers, and visitors through a single mobile application.

about_short_description.short_description: DoorsVision is a smart community and smart city technology platform.

product.name: Smart Community Platform
product.description: A platform integrating IoT, AI, cloud computing, and big data to enhance community services like energy, water, waste management, and public safety.

product.name: Smart Access
product.description: Enables users to unlock doors, gates, lifts, and drawers in both commercial and residential properties using a smartphone.

product.name: Smart Visitors System
product.description: Allows users to invite visitors securely and be notified upon their arrival, enhancing security and convenience.

product.name: Smart Home and Energy Management
product.description: Users can control lights, devices, and adjust room temperature remotely, alongside monitoring energy usage through an app.

product.name: Place Discovery and Reservation
product.description: Facilitates the discovery of places and direct communication with them, including navigation and reservation options based on availability.

product.name: Service Provider Communication
product.description: Enables finding and communicating with nearby service providers like restaurants and shops directly through the app.
